format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: the carrier is hidden, has no role and puts SF.InlineEditor in place
edit() makes the element a named textbox; Enter commits: sf-inline-editor-change {id, content}, then the dated sf-inline-edit-commit {node_id, content}
probes.covers: actions.edit, events.change, aliases.json sf-inline-edit-commit, keyboard Enter, lang runtime.editing

steps.check: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#p1'); return p.getAttribute('role') === 'textbox' && p.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Абзац: редактирование. Enter — сохранить, Escape — отменить.' && document.activeElement === p && !!document.querySelector('.sf-inline-editor-toolbar[role=toolbar]'); })()

probes.title: Mod+B toggles bold and sends input {id, content}; Escape puts the element back: cancel {id}, then the dated sf-inline-edit-cancel
probes.covers: events.input, events.cancel, keyboard Mod+B, Escape, aliases.json sf-inline-edit-input, sf-inline-edit-cancel

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#ed').edit(document.querySelector('#h1'), {nodeId: 'h1', label: 'Заголовок'}), (() => { const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(document.querySelector('#h1')); const selection = getSelection(); selection.removeAllRanges(); selection.addRange(range); })(), true)
